2023_018_jul_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's procurement-card (PCARD) report for July 2023, carried on the Board of Education agenda of September 19, 2023, itemizes every district purchasing-card transaction charged between June 27, 2023 and July 25, 2023, each posted under the journal-entry description "JULY PCARD EXP." The schedule, printed 9/14/2023 and running through page 11, lists transaction description, budget unit, account code, transaction amount and credits. Charges subtotal 127,308.19 against 401.88 in credits, leaving total expenses of 126,906.31. The single largest line is 8,065.00 to C & G Publishing, charged to budget unit 101928282087400, account 3510.

**Nature of the report**

The Troy School District PCARD report for July 2023 is a transaction-level listing of district purchasing-card activity submitted for Board of Education review on the agenda of September 19, 2023. Every row carries the journal-entry description "JULY PCARD EXP." Transaction dates run from 6/27/2023 through 7/25/2023, meaning charges made in the last days of June are posted in the July billing cycle.

**Stated totals**
